extracted.name: Brown Bears
extracted.description: Brown bears are campfire bread made from canned biscuit dough, butter, white sugar, and ground cinnamon. Both kids and grown-ups will love the recipe.
instruction_lines: Mix sugar and cinnamon together in a shallow bowl. Pour melted butter into a separate shallow bowl.
Separate biscuits; form each dough piece into a rope 4 to 5 inches long. Wrap dough pieces around skewers.
Hold skewers over campfire; slowly turn until biscuit dough is browned and set, 8 to 10 minutes.
Dip biscuits into melted butter, then dredge in cinnamon-sugar.
